articles.author: Laura Kuenssberg
articles.title: Keir Starmer faces pressure over UK budget plans
articles.description: The prime minister and Treasury are under pressure in Westminster over tax and public spending.
articles.content: Labour MPs said the UK government must rethink the budget after criticism in Parliament and Westminster.

articles.author: Beth Rigby
articles.title: Reform UK and Conservatives clash over election strategy
articles.description: Nigel Farage and Conservative figures traded criticism ahead of local elections in England.
articles.content: The local election campaign intensified as Reform UK challenged the Conservatives across England.
